subject: general
question: What is the main religion of Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Theravada Buddhism **is the main religion of **Myanmar**.
 
• Nearly 88% population of Myanmar follows Buddhi
